name: Mousou Speaker ~H na Mousou ga Kikoete Kuru yo~
original_name: モウソウスピーカー～Ｈな妄想が聴こえてくるよ～
source:
Itsuki gains the ability to hear the thoughts of the girls around him. He can hear the lewd thoughts of honor student Kanou Kasumi, who secretly wants to have sex with him. He can hear the secret desires of Nanami Umi, who wants to be caught masturbating and have sex in public spaces and he can hear the secret thoughts of his younger sister Oouchi Sachi who wants to commit incest with her brother.

Now that he knows their desires how will he proceed in his relationship with these girls?
translation:
伊月获得了能够听到周围女孩的想法的能力。他能听到优等生加纳霞的淫荡想法，后者暗中想和他发生性关系。他可以听到七海海的秘密欲望，他想被抓到在公共场所自慰并发生性行为，他可以听到他的妹妹大内幸的秘密想法，他想与她的兄弟乱伦。

既然他知道了她们的愿望，他将如何处理与这些女孩的关系呢？
